unresolvedConflicts.subject: Acadia Infrastructure Capital manager identity and manifest scope
unresolvedConflicts.issue: The supplied manager universe names Acadia Infrastructure Capital, while the authoritative repository snapshot has canonicalManager null and knownManager false. Under the contract, the snapshot flag controls, requiring OUT_OF_SCOPE_UNKNOWN_MANAGER and prohibiting any fund or program additions.
unresolvedConflicts.recommendedResolution: Have the fund-manifest owner perform a controlled review of Acadia Infrastructure Capital LP and decide whether to add it as a canonical manager. If approved, rerun the census to evaluate its bespoke structured-equity mandates and the Climate and Communities Investment Coalition without automatically treating either as a distinct fund.
